scope: Bounded representative numerical qualification; not automatic scene-specific admission of 184 trajectories
physical_parameter_binding: pending: current frozen study records IDs/seeds/counts, not actual per-seed soil/weather/material values
selection: Freeze physical inputs first; deterministic maximin coverage of soil/material categories and numerical stiffness descriptors, including extrema; reuse the 16 planned validation pairs where their frozen coverage permits
descriptors: thermal diffusivity and skin Fourier number
burial depth and radius relative to cell width
production_admission: Own source/input/physical bounds and executed conservation checks on every trajectory. Representative passing results are empirical envelope evidence, not an individual refinement certificate. Existing scene-specific accepted metadata remains reserved for actual passing direct certificates; no automatic promotion from this plan.

strict_full_protocol_accounting.note: Before exact source/input deduplication, and excluding any extra counterfactuals demanded for the unpaired direct scenes. This is not 9 times 184; absence requires no target-regularization solve.

capacity_guard: Use measured full-day fine runtimes and an actual Cloud Billing SKU quote before any CPU-only farm. No new VM launched by this plan. Current GPU VM is insufficient for all per-scene refinements within 20h at the present throughput; do not assert otherwise.
budget_guard: Root coordinates remaining EUR1000 project cap. Freeze and price a finite qualification stage first; never expand unboundedly after a failing representative.
failure_policy: Keep failing strata unaccepted, preserve evidence, revise their discretization and repeat their actual gates. Never reduce the physical day, spin-up, convergence thresholds or scene counts to claim completion.
